correctness.rationale: For fixed integer frequency the mask defects from one are summable, so a product without a finite zero factor is nonzero. At level j the unique rational cyclotomic relation of degree below 2^j pairs coefficient counts at residues separated by 2^(j−1); this is equivalent to exactly balanced refinements and is impossible at odd K. For even K, subtracting the distinguished exponent from K independent Haar exponents preserves the zero events and leaves K−1 independent Haar differences. Conditional on labeled prefix classes the next bits are fresh independent fair bits; hence the sorted occupancies suffice even when conditioning on all past failures to hit. An odd prefix cannot have only even descendants at any later prefix, and all live non-self moves strictly refine the number of blocks. The self-loops have weights 2^(b−K)<1, so descending block count proves rationality. At fixed depth L, both the event already hit and the event still live are periodic. The latter has Haar mass bounded by (1−min_s q(s))^L; bounding the lattice proportion between the hit count and the hit-plus-live count and then sending L to infinity proves centered-cube density. Independent enumeration of eight labeled bits recovers the four live states and the exact rational generating function and total; independent multinomial enumeration of anchored occupancy histograms mod 8 gives first-hit counts 573440, 76160, 11795 out of 8^7. This also distinguishes cumulative count 5075 from level-two first-hit count 595 mod 4, despite shorthand in the verification notes.
residual_risks: The finite calculations check the K=8 coefficients and residue counts; the all-K and infinite-scale claims use the proof, not census extrapolation.

originality.rationale: Pass for the even-occupancy first-hit density theorem and the eight-atom law, not for the standard Fourier product, prime-power cancellation rule, or its immediate odd-K consequence. The strongest inspected exact catalogue results give K=2 and K=4 at dyadic scale, and the closest original Sierpinski comparison describes a four-digit continuous zero locus. None of those mathematically implies the all-even-K rational centered-cube limit or the K=8 first-hit law. Related inaccessible primary texts remain explicit bounded risks.
residual_risks: Strichartz (1993) and Lu–Dong–Zhang (2019) were not independently accessible. The focused primary search was not exhaustive.
Subcase catalogue matches are not claims of chronological priority.

value.rationale: The natural density measures the integer characters annihilated by convolution with a canonical dyadic simplex measure. The finite-state reduction explains rationality despite infinitely many overlapping zero levels, and the first-hit law gives exact null-frequency counts at arbitrary fixed resolutions. The structural all-even-K theorem, rather than the isolated fraction or the elementary odd-K observation, provides the main value.
residual_risks: No assertion about spectral bases, noninteger Fourier zeros or uniform decay rates.
